caption: Samaltak · Debugger and Profiler. Every click and keystroke here is sent remotely through samaltak-ctl.
spoken: This is Samaltak's debugger and profiler. Nobody is touching the mouse: every click and keystroke is sent remotely, through samaltak control.

caption: Breakpoints live in the image: pick Integer>>gcd: in the System Browser and click the dot next to it.
spoken: Breakpoints live in the image. In the System Browser, pick Integer, gcd, and click the dot next to the method.

caption: Start the Mandelbrot rendering in its own Process, then print 48 gcd: 18 in the Workspace (⌘P).
spoken: Start the Mandelbrot rendering in its own process. Then, in the workspace, print forty-eight gcd eighteen.

caption: The breakpoint hits. The Debugger is its own Process: the Workspace is suspended, the Mandelbrot keeps rendering.
spoken: The breakpoint hits. The debugger runs in its own process: the workspace is suspended, while the Mandelbrot keeps rendering.

caption: Step Over: the highlighted statement moves through gcd:, and the temps update live.
spoken: Step over. The highlighted statement moves through the method, and the temporaries update live.

caption: Evaluate in the stopped frame: a + b, printed with ⌘P.
spoken: Evaluate right in the stopped frame: a plus b.

caption: Proceed: the computation finishes and the Workspace prints the result.
spoken: Proceed. The computation finishes, and the workspace prints the result.

caption: A message nobody implements: 3 zork. The notifier offers to Create the method.
spoken: Now a message nobody implements: three zork. The notifier offers to create the method.

caption: Write the method right in the Debugger, accept with ⌘S, then Proceed: the original send is retried.
spoken: Write the method right in the debugger, accept it, and proceed. The original send is retried.

caption: Watchpoints reuse the immutability bit: inspect p := 3 @ 4, right-click x, choose Halt on write.
spoken: Watchpoints reuse the immutability bit. Inspect a point, right-click its x, and choose halt on write.

caption: A forked Process moves p. The store into x is refused, and the Debugger opens on the writing statement.
spoken: A forked process moves the point. The store into x is refused, and the debugger opens on the writing statement.

caption: Unwatch and Proceed: the store is retried and the mover runs to completion.
spoken: Unwatch, and proceed. The store is retried, and the process runs to completion.

caption: The Profiler is always on: a 1 MB ring of stack samples. Fork a long computation, render the Mandelbrot, open the Profiler.
spoken: The profiler is always on: a one-megabyte ring of stack samples. Fork a long computation, keep the Mandelbrot busy, and open the profiler.

caption: Flame graph of every Process. Click a frame to zoom into it.
spoken: Here's a flame graph of every process. Click a frame to zoom in.

caption: Filter by Process: one click profiles just the Mandelbrot window.
spoken: Filter by process. One click profiles just the Mandelbrot window.

caption: Tally: the classic Smalltalk MessageTally tree, from the same samples.
spoken: The tally view: the classic Smalltalk message tally tree, built from the same samples.

caption: Allocations are sampled on the bump allocator’s limit check, so the fast path is unchanged.
spoken: Allocations are sampled from the bump allocator's limit check, so the fast path stays unchanged.

caption: Frame timeline: per frame, which Processes ran, plus draw, raster, GPU and GC. Drag to select a range.
spoken: The frame timeline shows, per frame, which processes ran, and the time spent drawing, rasterizing, on the GPU, and in GC. Drag to select a range.

caption: The selected range now filters the flame graph.
spoken: The selected range now filters the flame graph.

caption: Debugger, Profiler, every window: all driven remotely through samaltak-ctl.
spoken: Debugger, profiler, every window: all driven remotely, through samaltak control.
